Cave Passive Pedals browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Cave Passive Pedals Blue Juice Published on April 19, 2010 Cave Passive Pedals overdrive pedal Information Cave Passive Pedals The Blue Juice overdrive pedal recreates the warm, classic overdriven tones of the 1960's hard blues era. From real edgy lead sounds to blistering rhythms, you're sure to find a sound that suits. Turn the bite control anti-clockwise to add more drive and use the squash control to tighten or loosen up the drive tone.
